scene: The retro cabinet doles out tickets to three exciting city destinations.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view on the shop's back transit pier. On the far left, a wicker lift cage hangs ready. Left of centre, the boy stands with his skateboard. Centre shows a red paddle steamer docked by the water. On the far right, an open yellow shuttle van idles beside a ticket post.
shown: a wicker lift cage suspended from thick ropes on the far left
a red paddle steamer moored along the dock edge in the centre
a yellow skate-park shuttle van parked on the far right
